title: Analytic: 3D Fabry-Perot slab transmission (plane wave, FDTD)
description:
A normally incident plane-wave pulse (+x, E along y) crosses a lossless slab (n = 2, d = 500 nm) in a 4 x 4 cell column, periodic along y and z, CPML along x (em_fdtd_3d, 10 nm cells, runs in seconds). The plane wave is one-sided: its box opens into the x_hi CPML, so the reflected plane (x = 0.2 um, before the box) sees only the reflection.
Analytic (Airy): T = 1 / (1 + F sin^2(2 pi n d / lambda)), R = 1 - T, F = ((n^2 - 1)/(2 n))^2 = 0.5625; peak T = 1 at 1000 nm, dips T = 0.64 at 1333 nm and 800 nm; incident cw power P_inc = A^2 Ly Lz / (2 eta0).
Spectra tab: select em.transmitted and em.reflected (power, a.u. = 2 |S(f)|^2 x the cw power, S = the gaussian pulse spectrum; reflected flows toward -x, so it is negative) vs the dashed Airy spectra; choose Reference = em.transmitted: the ratio plot shows em.reflected / em.transmitted = -R/T = -F sin^2(2 pi n d / lambda), dashed (independent of the source normalisation, ~1e-3).
Derived values tab: T_peak, T_dip, T_dip2 and R_dip from power_per_cw / P_inc with the Airy references; they read low by O(dx^2): the discrete incident power is cos(k0 dx/2) cos(omega dt/2) of P_inc (~0.999 at 10 nm cells), and the Yee slab faces reflect like an index n cos(k0 dx/2) / cos(n k0 dx/2), which raises F (T_dip2 at 800 nm ~0.4 % low; at 20 nm cells ~1.4 %, over tolerance).

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (40 per slab wavelength at 800 nm)

parameters.name: Lp
parameters.description: transverse period along y and z (4 cells)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain length along x (cpml on both x faces)

parameters.name: n_slab
parameters.description: slab refractive index

parameters.name: d_slab
parameters.description: slab thickness (50 cells; both faces on cell edges)

parameters.name: x_slab
parameters.description: slab front face

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: upstream face of the plane-wave box (incident from here on)

parameters.name: x_refl
parameters.description: reflection flux plane (scattered-field region)

parameters.name: x_trans
parameters.description: transmission flux plane, behind the slab

parameters.name: A_src
parameters.description: incident peak E [V/m]

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: pulse centre wavelength

parameters.name: bw
parameters.description: relative bandwidth of the pulse

parameters.name: f0
parameters.description: pulse centre frequency [Hz]

parameters.name: tau_pulse
parameters.description: gaussian envelope width [s]: g(t) = sin(2 pi f0 (t - t0)) exp(-((t - t0)/tau)^2)

parameters.name: P_inc
parameters.description: incident cw power [W] through one period: A^2 Ly Lz / (2 eta0)

parameters.name: F_coef
parameters.description: coefficient of finesse of the slab in vacuum (0.5625 for n = 2)

parameters.name: lambda_peak
parameters.description: transmission peak (order m = 2): 1000 nm

parameters.name: lambda_dip
parameters.description: transmission dip: 1333 nm

parameters.name: lambda_dip2
parameters.description: transmission dip: 800 nm

parameters.name: band_start
parameters.description: shortest monitored wavelength

parameters.name: band_stop
parameters.description: longest monitored wavelength (59 points, 10 nm apart)

parameters.name: T_run
parameters.description: study duration: pulse, slab ring-down and the reflection past x_refl
